messages:
Samir: FYI, noticed a spike in SSO session fingerprint churn and ~2% 401s after the RBAC rollout at 03:35 UTC. Also seeing SCIM webhook retries piling up in prod-eu. Could be tied to KMS rotation?
Maya: Can you paste a couple of sample logs / correlation ids?
Samir: snippet:
```
2026-03-21T03:42:10Z svc=auth id=abc123 event=session_update fingerprint=fd3a7c... status=401 err=invalid_sig key_alias=projects/redwood/kms/keys/idp-signing-v2
```
AJ: That invalid_sig + key_alias points at a KMS Decrypt failure when verifying session signatures. Did we rotate idp-signing-v2 yesterday?
Oliver: We rotated idp-signing-v2 at ~03:30 and rolled the terraform change at 03:32. We had a fallback in code but it looks like the signer principal lost access.
SRE Oncall: I can see KMS proxy logs showing PERMISSION_DENIED from principal service-account:idp-signer@redwood-prod at 03:33-03:36 UTC, retries afterwards.
SecBot: Audit: terraform apply by @oliver at 2026-03-21T03:32 (PR #678). IAM binding changed: removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for group infra-idp-signers.
Maya: If that binding dropped, idp-signer wouldn't be able to decrypt signing keys -> session verify fails -> clients get kicked and reauthenticate -> fingerprint churn.
Samir: Confirmed via iam: get-iam-policy snapshot: idp-signer group missing decrypt role on key ring. Workaround: re-add binding and restart auth pods. I'll apply now.
AJ: Also observed SCIM 429s around the same window due to backlog; likely a downstream symptom but worth throttling retries while we stabilize.
Oliver: Plan: 1) rebind KMS role (Samir) 2) restart idp-signer workers (Samir/SRE) 3) throttle SCIM retries and drain queue (SRE Oncall) 4) monitor 15m then resume canary 5) postmortem + terraform rollback if needed.
Maya: Assigning owners: Samir + AJ to remediate, Oliver to coordinate postmortem. I'll open incident doc and add timeline.
SRE Oncall: Throttling SCIM retries now and scaling additional worker to help backlog.
Samir: Fix applied: rebind completed at 03:58 UTC, restarted auth pods at 03:59 UTC. Error rate dropped back to baseline by 04:05 UTC. Collecting logs for audit evidence.
AJ: Good recovery. Follow-ups: add deploy gate test to validate principal canKmsDecrypt for any KMS key changed by infra PRs; add KMS role smoke test to CI.
Oliver: Also add an alert for session fingerprint churn >0.5% over 5m and an incident runbook for KMS-caused sign/verify issues.
SecBot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-00321. Linked PR=678 and audit entries.
Samir: :thumbsup: closing the immediate triage. Leaving incident open for postmortem and follow-ups.
